subject: Re: Implementation phasing, SOW edits & pricing impact
messages:
From: Alyssa Park <alyssa.park@callisto.ai>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@callisto.ai
Date: 2028-06-25T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Implementation phasing, SOW edits and pricing questions

Hi Rafael,

Thanks for the demo last week. We reviewed the draft Order Form and the attached SOW (Callisto_SOW_v2.docx) and have a few requests before procurement can move to signature: 

- We need to increase committed throughput by ~20% starting in Q4 (estimate attached in the SOW). Can you confirm how that delta will affect the monthly committed fee and whether we can phase the increment across three months?
- Callisto is also asking to reclassify part of the implementation services in the SOW from "Professional Services" to "Managed Onboarding" (we marked the paragraphs in Callisto_initial_redlines.pdf). That will impact timing and invoice schedule.
- Please confirm that Redwood will provide SOC 2 Type II evidence and details on audit log retention (we store PHI-adjacent telemetry).

We attached our suggested redlines and a revised SOW. Procurement is hoping for an updated MSA redline and an Order Form that reflects a phased ramp and proration for the Q4 increase. Our internal approvers will need to see the proration math.

Can you loop in pricing/legal? We need this to move quickly — target signature by mid-July.

Thanks,
Alyssa Park
Director, Procurement | Callisto Therapeutics
procurement@callisto.ai

Attachments: Callisto_SOW_v2.docx; Callisto_initial_redlines.pdf

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Park <alyssa.park@callisto.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-26T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Implementation phasing, SOW edits and pricing questions

Alyssa — thanks for the clear notes and the marked-up SOW. Looping in Karthik (pricing) and Laura (legal) to help. Quick answers up front:

- Impact on committed fee: Karthik, see attached spreadsheet (redwood_pricing_impact_20280626.xlsx) with an illustrative proration and three-month ramp. High level: ~+18% run-rate on committed fee if fully committed by month 2; proration approach reduces Q4 invoice by spreading the incremental billing across months of ramp.
- Reclassification of implementation line items: we can move those line items to a "Managed Onboarding" exhibit and change invoicing milestones — this will require an SOW edit and an amendment to the Order Form.
- SOC 2 & audit logs: Laura, can you confirm standard language and retention windows we can commit to for Callisto? Alyssa, we can provide SOC 2 Type II attestation and a summary of log retention; for detailed logs we typically offer a 12-month standard window and longer retention as a paid add-on.

Next steps I propose:
1) Laura to provide high-level redline on the MSA & Order Form (we'll produce Redwood_MSA_redlines_20280629.pdf).
2) Karthik to confirm final numbers and send an updated Order Form with proration math.
3) I will prepare a proposed phasing schedule (proposed_phasing_plan.pdf) and a DocuSign envelope for the Order Form once redlines are agreed.

If Callisto can accept a short trial credit to offset any partial-month billing for the ramp we can reduce the Q4 cash impact — is that something procurement would consider?

Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132

Attachments: redwood_pricing_impact_20280626.xlsx; proposed_phasing_plan.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Park <alyssa.park@callisto.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-27T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Implementation phasing, SOW edits and pricing questions

Alyssa / Rafael — I dug into the numbers and sketched two options in the attached spreadsheet:

Option A (phased ramp):
- Month 0: baseline committed throughput (no change)
- Month 1: +10% committed (billed at 50% of delta)
- Month 2: +20% committed (billed at remaining 50% of delta)
Net effect: Callisto sees a smoothed cash impact over two invoices; Redwood recognizes committed uplift in Month 2.

Option B (immediate top-up with credit):
- Full +20% goes live immediately; Redwood issues a one-time credit equal to partial-month overlap for Month 0.

Notes: both approaches require an Order Form amendment and DocuSign for execution. If procurement needs the PO to match invoice timing, let us know the PO date and we will align the effective date.

Alyssa — does Callisto have a preference? If you confirm Option A I will draft the specific fee table and the proration rows for the Order Form.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Pricing | Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Park <alyssa.park@callisto.ai>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-29T10:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Implementation phasing, SOW edits and pricing questions

Alyssa — attaching our high-level redline PDF (Redwood_MSA_redlines_20280629.pdf). Highlights / asks from legal: 

1) Implementation reclassification: acceptable in principle, but we need a short amendment that:
   - Moves the identified sections into Exhibit G (Managed Onboarding);
   - Updates acceptance criteria and milestone invoicing to reflect service-delivered acceptance rather than time-based invoicing.
2) Data & compliance: we can commit to SOC 2 Type II attestation and a 12-month standard audit-log retention. For any extended retention (24+ months) we need an addendum with fees. Please confirm what Callisto requires.
3) Security carve-outs: Callisto asked for guaranteed encryption-at-rest and customer-key options for certain workloads; we can offer customer-managed keys (KMS) for the private deployment lanes — add a DPA exhibit pointer in the MSA redline.
4) Audit & proof: procurement asked for evidence — I included a pointer to our compliance pack in the redline and we can provide the SOC report under NDA.

Next steps:
- Alyssa: confirm whether the 12-month retention is acceptable or if you need 24 months.
- Rafael / Karthik: once we agree on Option A vs B, Karthik to produce the final fee table and I will fold the Order Form language into the MSA amendment.
- Rafael: prepare DocuSign envelope and Order Form PDF once redlines are agreed.

Laura Bennett
Sr. Counsel, Commercial Contracts | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_redlines_20280629.pdf
